description: List published chart visualizations on Autario, built on the public catalog (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, WHO, IMF, SEC) and rendered with Plotly. Returns chart IDs, titles, insights, linked datasets, and creation dates. Use to discover existing analyses before building a new one, and to find a shareable autario.com/chart/{id} link for an answer.

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

limit.description: Maximum number of charts to return (default 20, max 100)

offset.description: Number of charts to skip for pagination

q.description: Search term to filter charts by title or question

name: list_charts
